description: One tool, eight actions: drive a Windows window quietly by default, and read the target as a numbered element frame. Prefers window messages (zero foreground change); falls back to UI Automation with a bounded, self-reversing focus flash (measured net return 15-95 ms); offers an opt-in takeover tier (takeoverAllowed) where the cursor moves to the action point and is always restored, with a mandatory three-phase HUD and three interruption paths; adds snapshot/screenshot/preview, where labels address the UIA element itself and image coordinates are converted by the engine; and since 0.6.0 reads a write back -- effect=readback-verified only when the field's own value matches a prediction built from the control's measurements -- with caretPosition, disabled/focus reporting, and a BitBlt capture path named in every screenshot as captureBackend.

tools.name: wpm
tools.description: Drive a Windows window quietly by default (actions: windows, status, click, type, focus, snapshot, screenshot, preview), with an opt-in takeover tier that is visible, interruptible and always restores the cursor, and a read surface whose numbered labels address the element itself.
